english.note: Use this when picking up or collecting a person, especially from a station, airport, or other place.

examples.english: I’ll collect you from the station tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 ce1 zaam6 zip3 nei5

english.note: Use 接 when intercepting an object thrown or moving through the air.

examples.english: I catch the ball in one go.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 je5 zip3 zyu6 go3 bo1
